fix-bug Phase C INTERMEDIATE investigation (dso:investigator-intermediate, opus): SCOPE=epic-scale, RECOMMENDED_ACTION=promote-to-epic. Touches 4 bridge modules (_handle_edit.py / _outbound_handlers.py / _inbound_api.py / _handle_links.py), 3 net-new sync axes (parent_id/Epic-Link, tags/Labels, blocks-depends_on/Blocks Issue Links), 1 cross-epic dependency (Epic 6f7a-4ba6 must land 'supersedes' relation first), 1 lossy precedence rule for supersedes-as-Relates. Cannot be a single fix-bug pass — exceeds atomic-task granularity (3-gate task rule). Phase D escalate-to-user: promote this bug ticket to an epic and decompose via /dso:preplanning into ≥4 stories. Leaving OPEN as escalated.

Already done: relates_to LINK/UNLINK bidirectional sync; 4 baseline EDIT fields; outbound sort ordering; BRIDGE_ENV_ID gate now operational.

Work remaining: extend _handle_edit.py to track parent_id/tags/links; extend _outbound_handlers.py to write Epic Link/Labels/Blocks; extend _inbound_api.py for inbound parsing; supersedes precedence rule; integration test matrix (4 directions × 4 axes).
